capabilities: List files differing from the last Git commit with status letters
Show Markdown and plain-text diffs for changed files
Discard changes to return files to HEAD or the trash
Filter the changes list with exclude patterns
Navigate changed files and diff hunks via commands
extras: Never enable alongside Better MD Diff, as both register the same view type; the vault must be the root of its Git repository; desktop only; not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the plugin makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: Uncommitted is a fork of kamacheng/better-md-diff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to review which files changed since the last Git commit or view those diffs inside the app.

relations.evidence: Uncommitted is a fork of kamacheng/better-md-diff.

summary: Git-based changes list that shows every vault file differing from the last commit, with status letters and read-only diffs for each change.
